items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1968-11-30
items.q: Dorf Lewis was saying to him the other day

ctx.x: Well, you see, I wasn't here. I couldn't give you no direct date on that.

But anyway, he was, that's one thing anyway, because he definitely didn't die. I was thinking, Dorf Lewis was saying to him the other day he thought he may be about before 1931, but he obviously didn't, that he was still alive. No, he was still alive. Yeah. Okay, well, that's something anyway. I have one thing I wanted to ask you about. You're reading some of this, and this is something this man interviewed before asked you about before. When they had some of these old, these dancers, you know, and they'd have…
